page_title: CRE 0-0 VER | Cremonese v Verona 19/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Alberto Arena is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' That's a well-taken pass by Roberto Gagliardini (Verona). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
90+3' Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
90+3' Giovane (Verona) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+1' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) makes a strong challenge and Alberto Arena blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Romano Floriani (Cremonese) replaces Tommaso Barbieri.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Grassi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Michele Collocolo (Cremonese).
89' Giovane (Verona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

89' Giovane (Verona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play and Verona manage to earn a corner.
87' Here is a change. Pol Lirola is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Daniel Oyegoke (Verona).
85' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Giovane (Verona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
83' The substitution is prepared. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jari Vandeputte.
81' Antoine Bernede (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emil Audero intercepts the ball.
80' The resulting corner from Abdou Harroui (Verona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

80' Antoine Bernede (Verona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Emil Audero, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes out for a corner. Verona can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Francesco Folino (Cremonese) is penalised for a foul. Alberto Arena had a clear view and blows his whistle.
76' Gift Orban (Verona) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
76' Antoine Bernede (Verona) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
74' Alberto Arena shows a yellow card to Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) for his blatant foul.
74' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) swings it in and Faris Moumbagna gets on the end of it, but Simone Perilli shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Bonazzoli departs the field of play to be replaced by Faris Moumbagna (Cremonese).
73' It will be a substitution. Francesco Folino (Cremonese) is ready to enter the pitch as Federico Ceccherini walks off.
72' Giovane (Verona) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
71' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdou Harroui (Verona) replacing Enzo Ebosse.

68' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Simone Perilli was alert and the score remains the same.
66' That's the end of the game for Amin Sarr, who is replaced by Suat Serdar (Verona).
64' Emil Audero displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Gift Orban (Verona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
62' A pass into the box finds Giovane (Verona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Emil Audero denies him.
59' Jamie Vardy almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
55' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
53' Giovane (Verona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
52' Amin Sarr (Verona) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
51' A cross from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
49' The corner is swung in but Cremonese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cremonese.
48' Pol Lirola (Verona) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
46' Alberto Arena blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Gift Orban (Verona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) was quite harsh and Alberto Arena didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Cremonese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
39' Giovane (Verona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

38' Giovane (Verona) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the bottom right corner of the target, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping! The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
37' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alberto Arena had an easy-decision to make.
36' A long ball forward to Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is intercepted.
32' Giovane (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
30' Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) commits a rough foul. Alberto Arena stops the game and makes a call.

29' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
28' Giovane (Verona) takes the corner which is cleared.
27' The free kick from close range, taken by Verona, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
27' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) jumps into a tackle and Alberto Arena signals a foul. Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
26' Antoine Bernede (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
25' A pass by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
24' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
23' Tobias Slotsager (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Alberto Arena blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Pol Lirola (Verona) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
19' The resulting corner from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is cleared by the defence.
18' The resulting free kick from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. Cremonese have a corner.
18' Alberto Arena blows the whistle, Amin Sarr (Verona) is penalised for a foul.
17' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) sends a cross in and finds Jamie Vardy inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
17' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
15' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
14' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
12' The corner from Giovane (Verona) is intercepted by the defence.

12' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play and Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
9' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) picks up a precise pass and attempts to threaten the keeper with a long-range effort, but it goes well wide of the mark.
7' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
4' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Pol Lirola (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Verona.
1' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cremonese will have the kick-off.
Alberto Arena will officiate today.
